note: [F] Deicyde/diophantine-z-q, no counterpart; ZInQ.Density.GaussSieve.abs_card_box_dvd_sub_le proved: The display is the residue-square count A_d = N^2 g(d) + R_d for general Omega_q with rho(q) <= 21q, a step of the proof of Proposition 6.2; [F] replaces that proposition by route AP and takes FixedPrimePattern unproved. Route AP's closest lemma is the box count abs_card_box_dvd_sub_le (and abs_rem_le), which counts only zeros of (lU)^2+(b+lV)^2 with error rho(d)(M1+M2+1), which by the taxonomy's replaced-argument rule is a support link, not a counterpart.

theorem abs_card_box_dvd_sub_le (ℓ b a₁ a₂ : ℤ) (M₁ M₂ d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) :
    |((#{x ∈ box a₁ a₂ M₁ M₂ | (d : ℤ) ∣ gaussFZ ℓ b x} : ℕ) : ℝ) -
        (Nat.card (ZSet (ZMod d) ℓ b) : ℝ) * (M₁ * M₂ / (d : ℝ) ^ 2)| ≤
      (Nat.card (ZSet (ZMod d) ℓ b) : ℝ) * (M₁ + M₂ + 1) := by
